maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding sentinel-6B (Mistral-ish) hit a weird combo: tokenizer maps a soft-hyphen-ish glyph to a sentinel id and int4 quant + our rotary packing causes a phase flip. dump below. :eyes:

asif: can you paste the exact prompt + outputs so we can bisect?

maya: short repro: prompt `Summarize: <article>` using eval harness. float16 output looks fine, int4 q4_0 has truncated tails and repeating phrases. small snippet: 
```
float16: "In summary, ... no contradictions found."
int4 q4_0: "In summary, In summary, In summary..."
```
also saw odd attention scores for token id 0xAD (soft hyphen).

sasha: hmm. two likely causes: 1) token id remapping (vocab conversion) causing KV cache offset for that token; 2) rotary headwise interleaving mismatch where even/odd pair order flips after quant pack. we've seen similar with other Mistral->Gemma imports.

eli: quick checks: run float16 vs int4 diff and inspect rotary angles for first 4 heads. run `python infra/rotary_probe.py --model sentinel-6B --heads 0-3 --dump angles.json` and also `python tools/compare_tokens.py --tok 0xAD --mapping-table out.map` to confirm mapping.

ci-bot: test-run 8161234575: q4_0 quant smoke: 20 prompts, rouge-L avg: 0.412 (float16 baseline 0.518), repeat-rate up x3. latency nominal. attached logs: /artifacts/8161234575/quant-smoke.log

maya: ran `compare_tokens.py` — mapping table shows sentinel char got aliased to token 2351 in our converter, whereas original model uses 2350. off-by-one. also `rotary_probe` shows a phase sign flip on even lanes after pack.

asif: off-by-one + phase flip = catastrophic alignment, yeah. try two experiments: (A) apply token-id delta +1 remap before KV insert; (B) change pack order to safewrap (swap even/odd before packing). which is faster to test?

maya: (A) cheap — I patched tokenmap on the fly: `sed -i 's/2350/2351/g' out.map` and re-ran quant inference. result: rouge-L 0.47, repeat-rate down to x1.6. still worse than fp16 but huge improvement.

sasha: nice. (B) is kernel-level but I can prototype a python reorder to simulate: `tools/rotary_reorder.py --mode swap_even_odd` — runs in-userland and should confirm if pack order was culprit.

eli: parallel experiment: re-quant with per-channel scale (q4_k_m) instead of q4_0; sometimes symmetric vs per-channel changes sign behavior of crosshead scales.

ci-bot: experiment matrix posted: /artifacts/8161234575/matrix.csv — rows: baseline-fp16, q4_0, q4_k_m, q4_0+token-remap, q4_0+reorder-sim.

maya: short update: q4_0 + token-remap + reorder-sim = near-parity on small summarization set (rouge-L 0.50). looks like both fixes are additive.

asif: ok we should: 1) persist tokenmap fix in converter (bug likely in tokenizer export script), 2) add a packing compat test in onboarding CI (rotary parity smoke), 3) file kernel patch issue for packing order and label as P0 for dedicated quant kernels.

sasha: I'll take the kernel patch. creating PR draft and adding reproducer.

maya: created ticket ENG-ML-1123 with repro and attach artifacts. adding short unit test to onboarding harness to check token-id alignment + rotary parity.

eli: also add a quick metric alert in console: if rouge-L drop > 0.05 between fp16 and quant candidate on the small eval harness, block rollout.

asif: thanks — great triage. tagging infra and runtime: @sre for kernel rollout window. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: note: next scheduled dedicated-run for sentinel-6B at 8161238000 (will include sasha's reorder branch).
